search_intent: How an international buyer should choose between a new, unused-stock or used electric vehicle exported from China
buyer_task: Decide whether a new/unused-stock/used EV exported from China can be imported, registered and supported in a specific Middle East state, and whether the used discount is justified.

sources.title: U.S. DOE Alternative Fuels Data Center
sources.organization: U.S. DOE Alternative Fuels Data Center
sources.facts_supported: All-Electric Vehicles, Driving Range: extreme outside temperatures tend to reduce BEV range because more energy is used to heat or cool the cabin; rapid acceleration, heavy loads, uphill and highway speed also reduce range. General qualitative finding, gives no numeric range.

sources.title: Zakat, Tax and Customs Authority of Saudi Arabia
sources.organization: Zakat, Tax and Customs Authority of Saudi Arabia
sources.facts_supported: Light vehicles/buses/light transport <=3.5t model must not exceed 5 years; heavy trucks >3.5t operational life <=5 years; energy-efficiency certificate + SASO inquiry; prohibited: salvage/sunk/fire/overturn/structural-damage, ex-taxi/police, RHD-to-LHD converted, tampered chassis, stolen; valuation uses submitted invoice, if unsatisfied local-agent new-car lists with 10% annual depreciation capped 50%; GCC first-point-of-entry fee mechanism; resident one private car per 3 years. Last update 31 Dec 2025.

sources.title: UAE Ministry of Industry and Advanced Technology
sources.organization: UAE Ministry of Industry and Advanced Technology
sources.facts_supported: Smart e-service for imported-used-vehicle licences; national requirements prohibit import/licensing/insuring of 7 categories (burnt-out, scrapped, flooded, disassembled, damaged-beyond-repair, major manufacturing defect, etc.); imported light vehicles for re-export excluded. Page is a closed 2023 consultation describing the standing service; site updated 17/06/2026.

sources.title: Qatar General Authority of Customs
sources.facts_supported: Chairman Decision No.12 of 2015 Customs Value Instructions: Art.2 carriage per carrier freight receipts (estimate from identical/similar if absent); insurance per insurer receipts, if absent add 1% of goods value to reach customs value (CIF); authority may doubt declared value; importer given up to 90 days to justify; related-party and discount rules.
